description: This file defines classes and functions related to acceleration enrichment calculation and wall wetting (fuel film) management in an engine control firmware project. It contains class declarations, function prototypes, and includes for dependencies, specifically for the accel_enrichment module.

classes.name: AccelEnrichmemnt
classes.description: Represents acceleration enrichment logic, including rate-of-change corrections for MAP and TPS signals, managing previous values and buffers.

classes.name: WallFuel
classes.description: Handles wall wetting (fuel film) effects, managing fuel on the walls for each injector and adjusting fuel squirt durations accordingly.

methods.name: getEngineLoadEnrichment
methods.description: Calculates additional fuel enrichment based on engine load.

methods.name: getTpsEnrichment
methods.description: Calculates additional fuel enrichment based on TPS acceleration.

methods.name: getMaxDeltaIndex
methods.description: Returns the maximum delta index used in acceleration calculations.

methods.name: getMaxDelta
methods.description: Returns maximum delta value for acceleration correction.

methods.name: onEngineCycle
methods.description: Processes engine cycle updates for acceleration enrichment.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal states for acceleration enrichment or wall fuel management.

methods.name: setLength
methods.description: Sets buffer length or related parameter for acceleration calculations.

methods.name: onNewValue
methods.description: Handles new input value for acceleration calculations.

methods.name: adjust
methods.description: Adjusts fuel squirt duration considering wall wetting effects.

methods.name: getWallFuel
methods.description: Retrieves current wall fuel amount for a specific injector.
